The regular-expression denial of service is in Sinatra's If-Match / If-None-Match parsing, which runs only when a route calls the etag helper. gitlab-exporter never calls etag, and the upstream advisory limits impact to Ruby below 3.2, while this image runs Ruby 3.3. The fix needs sinatra 4.2.0 and rack 3.x, which the gemspec's exact sidekiq 6.5.12 pin (rack 2.x) blocks.

The vulnerability is in Sinatra's redirect handling of the X-Forwarded-Host header, reachable only from a route that calls redirect. gitlab-exporter serves only GET metric-probe routes and issues no redirects. The fix needs sinatra 4.1.0 and rack 3.x, which the gemspec's exact sidekiq 6.5.12 pin (rack 2.x) blocks.
